description: This file contains unit tests for the class 'PipelineFunctionFilter' within the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests various filtering functions related to pipeline processing, especially focusing on method behaviors, pattern matching, and the use of mock dependencies.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionFilterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for 'PipelineFunctionFilter', testing filtering logic, pattern matching, and interaction with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Verifies the parameter definitions of the 'getSignature' method.

methods.name: applyReturnsExistingValueIfFilterConditionSucceeds
methods.description: Tests that 'apply' returns the known value when the filter condition passes.

methods.name: applyReturnsUnresolvedValueIfFilterConditionFails
methods.description: Tests that 'apply' returns empty when the filter condition does not pass.

methods.name: applyReturnsUnresolvedValueIfUnsupportedRqlFunctionDefined
methods.description: Ensures 'apply' returns empty if an unsupported RQL function is used.

methods.name: eqSucceedsWithBothValuesUnresolved
methods.description: Tests equality operation when both values are unresolved.

methods.name: eqFailsWithOneUnresolvedValue
methods.description: Ensures equality check fails if one value is unresolved.

methods.name: neFailsWithBothValuesUnresolved
methods.description: Tests that inequality check fails if both values are unresolved.

methods.name: neSucceedsWithOneUnresolvedValue
methods.description: Checks that inequality succeeds if only one value is unresolved.

methods.name: filterByLike
methods.description: Tests the 'like' pattern matching functionality with various patterns.

methods.name: filterSucceedsWithBothValuesUnresolved
methods.description: Verifies that filter passes when both header values are unresolved.

methods.name: filterFailsWithOneUnresolvedValue
methods.description: Ensures filtering fails if only one value is unresolved during a 'like' operation.
